name: bertbooker
//private: Prevents an accidental `npm publish`. It has nothing to do with the GitHub repo's visibility, which is public.
description: Self-hosted award-travel availability tracker on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.db:apply:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply bertbooker_db --local --persist-to .wrangler-local --config api/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:apply:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply bertbooker_db --remote --config api/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute bertbooker_db --local --persist-to .wrangler-local --config api/wrangler.toml --file seed/programs.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: wrangler d1 execute bertbooker_db --remote --config api/wrangler.toml --file seed/programs.sql
scripts.db:seed:airports:local: npm run db:seed:airports:table:local && npm run db:seed:airports:derived:local
scripts.db:seed:airports:remote: npm run db:seed:airports:table:remote && npm run db:seed:airports:derived:remote
scripts.//probe: BOTH SPEND METERED seats.aero CALLS. Read docs/SEATS-AERO.md before running either.
scripts.//dev: Runs the API and the SPA together. Ctrl+C stops both, and dev:api now releases its port on the way out; dev:api:stop is still there for a leftover from a hard kill.
scripts.//deploy: ONE artifact: the worker serves the API and the SPA. The build MUST come first — wrangler uploads app/dist as static assets, so deploying without it ships whatever bundle was lying around.
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config api/wrangler.toml
scripts.//test:ui: Drives the REAL SPA in headless Chrome. Reuses dev:api/dev:app if they are already up and starts them if not, so it is safe to run while somebody is working. Read docs/UI-TESTING.md before touching it — never --headed/--ui/show-report (they open a window), and never let a spec press Search (that spends seats.aero quota).
scripts.//ui:shot: Ad-hoc: go to a page, optionally click through it, write a PNG. `npm run ui:shot -- --path /library --theme review`. --help lists the flags and every theme id.
scripts.//typecheck: Five projects, because each has genuinely different compilerOptions: shared and api want @cloudflare/workers-types, app wants DOM + JSX, e2e wants node + Playwright. The fifth checks shared/src/wire ALONE with neither DOM nor workers-types — it is the narrowest, and it is the only pass that can catch a wire file reaching `fetch` or `Response`, which every other project's lib would happily accept while silently dragging the 1436-line seats.aero provider into the SPA's bundle. e2e is checked here rather than being picked up by `test`, which is vitest only.
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.wire.json && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p app/tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.//test: Offline and serverless, as it has always been. The browser suite is `test:ui` and stays out of this on purpose: it needs two servers and a real Chrome.
scripts.db:seed:airports:table:local: wrangler d1 execute bertbooker_db --local --persist-to .wrangler-local --config api/wrangler.toml --file seed/airports.sql
scripts.db:seed:airports:derived:local: wrangler d1 execute bertbooker_db --local --persist-to .wrangler-local --config api/wrangler.toml --file seed/airports_derived.sql
scripts.db:seed:airports:table:remote: wrangler d1 execute bertbooker_db --remote --config api/wrangler.toml --file seed/airports.sql
scripts.db:seed:airports:derived:remote: wrangler d1 execute bertbooker_db --remote --config api/wrangler.toml --file seed/airports_derived.sql
